items.exampleEn: People in my profession often work at night.
items.exampleZh: 我這一行的人常常要在晚上工作。

items.exampleEn: Only the top three runners qualify for the final.
items.exampleZh: 只有前三名的跑者能取得決賽資格。

items.exampleEn: The dog got a treat as a reward.
items.exampleZh: 狗得到一塊點心當作獎勵。

items.exampleEn: The government is trying to reduce unemployment.
items.exampleZh: 政府正試著降低失業率。

items.exampleEn: The prize is a trip to the mountains.
Hard work led to her promotion.
items.exampleZh: 努力工作讓她得以升職。

items.exampleEn: My parents give me a small weekly allowance.
items.exampleZh: 我爸媽每週給我一點零用錢。

items.sentenceEn: He won a prize for his photo.

items.audioEn: You need two years of training to qualify for this job.
items.audioZh: 你需要兩年的訓練才能取得這份工作的資格。

items.sentenceEn: Her reward for winning was a new bike.
items.sentenceZh: 她贏了比賽的獎勵是一輛新腳踏車。

items.stemEn: She got a ____ and is now the manager of her team.
items.stemZh: 她升職了，現在是她團隊的經理。

items.stemEn: Do I ____ for a student discount?
items.stemZh: 我有資格享有學生折扣嗎？

items.passageEn: My brother is a nurse, and he loves his profession. Last year, he studied hard and passed a difficult exam to become a head nurse. The hospital management gave him a promotion, and he now gets a travel allowance, too. This spring, he also won a prize for his work with patients. But he says the best reward is a patient's smile. Our town has high unemployment, so he feels very lucky to have a job he loves.
items.passageZh: 我的兄弟是護理師，他很熱愛自己的職業。去年他努力讀書，通過一場很難的考試，當上了護理長。醫院的管理階層讓他升職，現在他還有交通津貼。今年春天，他也因為照顧病人的表現得了獎。不過他說，最好的回報是病人的微笑。我們鎮上失業率很高，所以他覺得能有一份喜歡的工作很幸運。

questions.questionZh: 作者的兄弟現在還有什麼津貼？
作者的兄弟認為最好的回報是什麼？

items.promptZh: 我把零用錢存起來買書。
referenceEn: I save my allowance to buy books.
I save up my allowance so that I can buy books.
rubricZh: allowance 表示「零用錢、津貼」，例如 save my allowance 等說法
時態配合內容（例如說習慣用現在簡單式等）

referenceEn: Both of her parents are in the teaching profession.
Her parents both work in the teaching profession.
rubricZh: 用 profession 表示「職業」（例如 the teaching profession；寫 are both teachers 也正確）
